scenario_description:
Objective: Have Tuesday’s map-portfolio donation pickup leave through the service elevator bay rather than becoming a curbside-only handoff.
Emerging Need: A temporary freight-bay tag and elevator pad reservation are prerequisites, but vehicle details and the posted intake route surface only after the future pickup is scheduled.
Decision Context: Stored condo instructions distinguish this placard route from package notices, neighbor admission, or code sharing; live building updates determine when the missing prerequisite can still be secured.
Consequence: After the tag list closes, pickup can still arrive, but carts cannot use the bay and the donation transfer loses its intended practical path.

parameter.title: Map portfolio donation pickup
parameter.description: Twin Cities Archive volunteers are tentatively holding this window to collect sealed map portfolio boxes from Unit 1207; vehicle assignment still pending.

parameter.name: Loring House Freight Coordinator
parameter.notes: Posted roster contact for temporary freight-bay tags and service-elevator pad reservations for resident-scheduled pickups.

parameter.subject: Tuesday portfolio pickup vehicle confirmed
parameter.body: Our two volunteers are confirmed for Tuesday at 9:00 a.m. They will bring a folding portfolio dolly and hand truck for the sealed map boxes. Street parking is workable for sites without freight rules, but any building loading or service-elevator requirements need to be in place before arrival.

parameter.content: Monday dock desk reminder: Tuesday temporary freight-bay tags and service-elevator pad reservations close at 11:30 a.m. today. Unlisted third-party pickup vehicles will be directed to the curb lane; no package-room override.

parameter.subject: Tuesday freight-bay list is closed
parameter.body: The Tuesday freight-bay tag list closed at 11:30 a.m. today. The dock sheet now has no open add-on line for donation, archive, or haul-away pickups; curb-lane arrivals may not stage carts in the bay or reserve the service-elevator pads.
